create_distillation_loss_soft: create a DistillationLoss with soft distillation type using KL divergence and temperature scaling
create_distillation_loss_hard: create a DistillationLoss with hard distillation type using cross entropy on teacher model predictions
create_distillation_loss_none: create a DistillationLoss with no distillation that returns only the base criterion loss
run_distillation_loss_forward: run the DistillationLoss forward pass with inputs, model outputs, and labels to compute combined loss
review_distillation_loss_alpha_tau: review the DistillationLoss alpha weighting and tau temperature parameters for knowledge distillation tuning
